package fixture

import (
	"strings"

	core "github.com/johanix/tdns/v2/core"
	"github.com/miekg/dns"
)

// keyfold: a map key built by a lossy fold, directly.
func keyDirect(rrs []dns.RR, out map[string][]dns.RR) {
	for _, rr := range rrs {
		out[dns.CanonicalName(rr.Header().Name)] = nil
	}
}

// keyfold: folded into a local, then used as a key two statements later.
func keyViaLocal(name string, m map[string]bool) bool {
	k := dns.CanonicalName(name)
	return m[k]
}

// keyfold: a helper that RETURNS a key. No map in sight.
func zoneNameKey(name string) string {
	return strings.ToLower(dns.Fqdn(name))
}

// foldpair: tested through a fold, trimmed unfolded.
func stripPrefix(owner string) string {
	if strings.HasPrefix(core.CanonicalizeName(owner), "_dns.") {
		return strings.TrimPrefix(owner, "_dns.")
	}
	return owner
}

// namecmp: Unicode folding on a domain name.
func sameZone(qname, zonename string) bool {
	return strings.EqualFold(qname, zonename)
}

// namecmp: a byte suffix as a bailiwick test.
func inZone(qname, zonename string) bool {
	return strings.HasSuffix(qname, zonename)
}
